scoring_justification: T1 recompute is infeasible because no raw intermediate artifacts (site coordinates, potential energy grids) are submitted; only final transition energies and barriers are produced. T0 comparison to paper-reported gold with tolerances is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold transition energies (COF1_primary, COF102_site1, COF102_site2) and rotational barriers (COF1_barrier, COF102_barrier)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Tables 1 and 2 (quantum-rotational transition energies) and Fig. 7 caption (rotational barriers).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from the paper: Table 1 (∆E for j=0→1 = 8.61 meV), Table 2 (site1 8.93 meV, site2 12.78 meV); Fig. 7 caption (COF-1 barrier 41.25 meV, COF-102 barrier 35.18 meV).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper’s own reported results, verified against the manuscript text. No synthetic data is needed.

outputs.description: Lowest j=0→j=1 rotational transition energies for H2 at the primary binding site in COF-1 and at site1 and site2 in COF-102.
Rotational barrier heights for H2 at the primary adsorption sites in COF-1 and COF-102 (site1).

output_contract.notes: Each value is compared to the paper-reported reference using a hidden tolerance.
